method: Live measurements of the deployed main branch (commit 727024e) in a Chromium browser pane against a seeded local backend, using getBoundingClientRect/scrollWidth on real DOM. 'smallTapTargets' = interactive elements with width or height < 40px. 'tinyTextNodes' = leaf text nodes with font-size < 12px. 'screensTall' = page height / viewport height.

/my-work.note: Entire first screen is header + the full navigation list card (aside lg:hidden). Queue content only visible after scrolling ~700px.

/assessments.note: Rail + detail stack vertically; the technical submissions table and detail header overflow the 375px width and scroll horizontally inside their containers.

/incidents.note: 6-column table overflows; filter row wraps into 4 lines; two tab buttons + search + select + checkbox + count + 2 buttons all compete.

/event-groups.note: Table wider than viewport (473px in 375px) → horizontal scroll inside card.

/mission-center.note: Map begins 912px down (after nav + toolbar), list of Event Groups begins at 1502px; map and list never visible together on a phone.

/submissions/3 (SUBMITTED with 2 forms).canvasCards: 10 cards each 520px wide stacked at x=58 in a 375px viewport (single-column auto-fit; horizontal scroll inside canvas)
/submissions/3 (SUBMITTED with 2 forms).note: 11 screens of content, drag/resize canvas with fixed 520px cards, hover-only tile actions, 3D scene inside a card.

/my-work.note: Sidebar hidden below lg (1024px) so the full nav list renders above the content; queue rail (max-h 860px) then detail stack vertically — rail and detail never side by side on iPad portrait.

/submissions/3.canvasCards: 520px cards, single column at x=66 inside a 645px canvas (auto-fit gives 1 column below 1076px)
/submissions/3.note: Location hero alone is 726px tall (fields stacked above the 360px map).

/mission-center.note: Map 890px down, list 1644px down; the xl side-by-side grid does not apply on iPad portrait.

/incidents.note: Table fits at 661px but cells wrap heavily; filter toolbar wraps to 2-3 rows.

/my-work.note: Header shows raw role codes joined with dots (FIELD_WORKER · MAINTENANCE · MAINT_COORDINATOR · OFFICE_CHIEF · BRANCH_CHIEF · REVIEWER · ADMIN). Rail + detail side by side; detail panel ~760px wide.

/submissions/3.canvasCards: ALL 10 cards in ONE 520px column (report_header 520x300 at x=346, ... measurements 520x980); canvas needs 1076px for two columns but the content area only gives 1037px at 1440-wide laptops, so half the width is empty and the form is 3.8k px tall
/submissions/3.note: At the most common laptop width the auto-fit canvas degrades to a single column; two columns only appear on ≥1500px screens.

/mission-center.note: Map and list side by side (2fr / 0.8fr) — the only viewport where list↔map sync is usable without scrolling.

shell.breakpoints: Tailwind v4 defaults: sm 640, md 768, lg 1024, xl 1280, 2xl 1536. Sidebar rail is lg+; page grids mostly xl+. Header shows full role list (e.g. 'FIELD_WORKER · MAINTENANCE · MAINT_COORDINATOR · OFFICE_CHIEF · BRANCH_CHIEF · REVIEWER · ADMIN') as raw role codes.
